personal_info.title: Cloud Architect
personal_info.summary: Cloud architect with a focus on Azure landing zones, container platforms and platform engineering. Designs and runs Kubernetes-based platforms for mid-sized enterprises and guides their teams through the migration.

description: Operated Linux and VMware infrastructure for mid-sized customers
Introduced configuration management and automated the server provisioning
Azure migrations and landing zones for manufacturing and retail clients
Built container platforms and CI/CD pipelines for development teams
Architecture ownership for cloud platforms and platform engineering teams
Technical pre-sales and architecture reviews
Focus on distributed systems and network engineering
Bachelor thesis on automated provisioning of virtual infrastructure

projects.title: Azure Landing Zone
description: Designed the subscription structure, network topology and identity setup for the group's first Azure landing zone
Automated the build pipelines for the platform components

projects.title: Container Platform for Retail Applications
description: Built the managed container platform for 30 store and e-commerce applications
Introduced Helm-based deployments and monitoring for the application teams
Ran the platform in a shared on-call rotation during the first year

projects.title: Platform Automation Scripts
description: Replaced manual cluster housekeeping with scripted jobs for certificate rotation, namespace provisioning and cost tagging

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Kubernetes Platform
description: Designed the multi-tenant platform for twelve product teams with tenant isolation, quotas and self-service onboarding
Built the observability stack and the golden-path templates for the teams

projects.title: Cluster Cost Reporting
description: Built the internal cost reporting for the cluster fleet, from the billing export to the dashboards per team

projects.title: Migration of a Legacy Hosting Platform to Azure
description: Led the migration of 80 applications from a managed hosting provider to Azure, most of them onto the container platform
Defined the target architecture, the migration waves and the cut-over procedure with the application owners
Set up the platform team that runs the platform after the migration
